payload.claim: The acceptance criterion for this change specifies a witness that declares two globs ('tests/**' and '*_test.go') across six files, to prove the exclusion generalizes to multiple declared test-path patterns and to the slash-boundary semantics that make 'pkg/a_test.go' counted while 'a_test.go' is excluded. The committed test (tests/test_size.py's new test, and the suite-level test in tests/test_suite.py) only ever calls size_gate/the suite with a single-element test_paths list ('tests/**'), never with more than one pattern. Narrowing _under_test_path to only check the first declared pattern (test_paths[:1] instead of the full list) would keep every test in the diff green while breaking any repo that declares more than one test-path glob in policy.yaml, which is exactly the case the criterion's prose describes and the gates report as satisfied (criteria: pass).
